assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's one curated REVIEWED item at basis_commit, read end to end with its front matter: the canonical character monograph series/fx-fighter-kurumi-chan/characters/fukuga-kurumi-manga.md (FXK-P001, version 1.2, 106,065 bytes, status canonical, veto false), a self-contained portrait of the Japanese collected manga main narrative V01-V10 to V10 i0156 (24 April 2017), located by volume and page occurrence (Vnn iNNNN) and by the project's episode and claim IDs (FXK-Vnn-Dnnn, FXK-Vnn-Cnnn, FXK-SYN-Cnnn), with brief Japanese quotations. Its publication note records an independent self-containment PASS, a fidelity PASS after revision and a monograph-only retrieval probe. Paratext, later volumes, adaptations and real market history are excluded by the monograph itself. The volume readings, the decision and evidence ledger, the specialist studies and the audits it cites are not curated on this subject, and no claim rests on them directly. No primary source page was inspected for this assessment.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: V01-V10 story time, October 2008 to 24 April 2017, in located states: the founding events of 2008-2009 told in V01's retrospective captions; the five-year wait and the first trades from 14 February 2014 (V01); the retirement promise and return (V02, to 15 July 2014); escalation and the protective withdrawal (V03); the declined second add (V04); the realized peak and the 300-lot short sized to the gap (V05, early December 2014); the hand-cut losses of 5 December 2014 and the repudiation of the stop rule on or after 8 December (V06); the EUR/CHF ruin of 15 January 2015 (V07); the V08 nights, crisis and Mochiko's intervention; the V09 disclosure, bankruptcy (November 2015) and refused vow; and the April 2017 clerk (V10). Late disclosures (the 2012 friendship, her mother's 2008 process, the purpose of her father's 3,000,000 yen, her V09 account of greed since childhood) belong to her at every earlier state they predate where they are her own memories, and are not changes in her. The interval from V09's 2015 scenes to April 2017 is largely unshown, and nothing after V10 i0156 is evidence.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution); evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The monograph gives a conditional account of what changes her decisions, with counterexamples. Calm or chastened, she reasons in scenarios and can refuse a trade for lack of grounds (V04 i0115; V06 i0106). After a gain she raises size and target and minimizes risk in words (V03 i0053-i0055; V04 i0006; V08 i0008-i0015). Under a moderate open loss she rationalizes and delays the stop (V01 i0088-i0094; V06 i0009). Within reach of a numerical goal she sizes toward the remaining gap (FXK-SYN-C026, EVALUATION HIGH for V04-V08; V05 i0153-i0158; V07 i0143-i0148). Her insight is accurate and usually does not govern (FXK-SYN-C027); a structural act or a person whose regard she fears restrains her, and a stated intention to stop does not (section 4.4). It predicts her mistakes: averaging down with family money, the stopless franc position, the doublings plan. Not A: why she trades stays open between restitution, appetite and the narrator's curse (section 13.1), whether the V08 night was policy or incapacity is UNRESOLVED, and the account is untested by validation. Not C: the account discriminates by stakes, money label, goal distance and audience, and states where it stops.

Section 11.1 dates each volume's state and the reasons the page gives, and section 11.2 separates real change from late revelation: the failure to cut changes kind from felt incapacity with her father's money in the account (V01 i0131, i0135) to capacity shown and then refused (V06 i0013, i0046, i0099) to a doctrine stated in advance (V08 i0006); her meaning of responsibility moves from disclaimer and licence (V02) to a solitary duty (V07 i0140, i0149) to disclosure and payment by instalments (V09 i0106-i0107). Within-volume changes are located (the V05 retirement resolution followed within minutes by the 300-lot short; the V06 cut on 5 December and the repudiation on or after 8 December). Not A: the V09 change was tested once, under maximal pressure, and only by abstention after it; the 2015-2017 interval is largely unshown. Not C: the states are located with causes and the rival reading for V06 is kept.

Section 6 constrains her Japanese closely: 私 throughout with play variants (わたし once, one あたし by placement, mock-formal わたくし at V07 i0020); an address table by person and setting (bare 萌智子, 社長 at work after a self-correction, きずなさん with です/ます by age, ばななちゃん as Nana invited); cheerful casual baseline (じゃん, もん, hearts); listener shifts (performance and minimal assent to her father until V09's plain 'それは 誓えない…!'); pressure shifts (masculine-leaning self-commands, coarse katakana in anger, childlike fragments in panic, politeness as a wall, the softest request form for the gravest sentence at V08 i0123); and a lexicon that changes (取り返す to 稼ぐ, 爆益 to 爆損, 自己責任 disappearing in V09). Not A: her voice is lettering, not performed sound (section 6.7), and balloon attribution is graded in places. Not C: the forms, shifts and their triggers are located.

Section 5.1 and section 8 give a steady ordinary life with HIGH support across V01-V10: diligent convenience-store work and extra shifts (V02 i0012-i0013), housekeeping and cooking for her father (V04 i0115; V05 i0069, i0147; V08 i0044), repeated chart-checking as her one persistent habit (V01 i0056, i0071, i0078; V07 i0055, i0071), frugality, keepsakes, failed experimental cooking, and in 2017 serving, sweeping, minding the office and leading a welcome party (V10 i0012-i0015, i0113). The table separates stable habits, situational acts and accommodation. Not A: her 2017 residence, pay and remaining tax are unprinted, and whether sleeping at the office is taste or circumstance is not shown (V10 i0007). Not C: the habits recur across settings and persist unchanged through ruin.

Section 7 dates each tie from her side with what the page shows of the other side: her father as the person she most loves and most hides from, from the hidden journal of April 2009 (V01 i0038-i0039) through the slap and assent without commitment (V02) to the chosen confession, refused vow and accepted control of her wages (V09 i0063-i0107); steady trust toward Mochiko against an asymmetry of knowledge she never learns (section 2.3); reluctant mentor to Mebuki, moving toward trading against Mebuki's views without telling her (V02 i0141); a light, reliable tie to Yasuko; deference by age to Kizuna and warmth to Nana and Inago in 2017. Section 12 conditions conduct on whether someone she might burden is involved, with the family-money exception (V01 i0109-i0111). Not A: her response to learning Mochiko's 2012 thought, the V03 disclosure or Mebuki's loan is never shown. Not C: conduct varies by relationship in located, explained ways.

The monograph names three kinds of interior access (retrospective first-person captions chiefly in V01, thought balloons, and personified figures of her desire from V02) and documents the gap between inner and outer speech where she is most exposed: '大丈夫だよ!' at the Christmas table after panting alone (V06 i0118, i0148), '全然平気!' typed after the shock (V07 i0120, i0136), the debt-collector chorus (V07 i0128) and the inset reckoning of 3,807,983 yen behind a partial disclosure (V10 i0045). Narrator captions that interpret her from outside are labeled as such. Not A: her interior between V07's last page and V08's first deposit is short on the page, and the tempter's lines are attributed by drawn mouths at INFERENCE MODERATE-HIGH. Not C: the interior is directly lettered across volumes and the inner-outer gap is a located, recurring sign.

The account is located but rests on few episodes. She rarely confronts; the sharp cases are dated and brief ('誰のせいで' to her mother, V01 i0027; blame of Mochiko for the V02 steering, apologized for within a page, V08 i0121-i0123). Accused by Mebuki, she concedes luck and justifies herself only alone (V04 i0073-i0075); with Kizuna she assents while a fist clenches, the fist hers at INFERENCE MODERATE (V10 i0045); her comic mode is '下手くその 気持ちを 考えて 発言してください!' (V09 i0022). Section 12 grades the accused-or-criticized row MODERATE-HIGH and the friend's-lie row MODERATE. Not B: the sample of interpersonal conflict is a handful of scenes, and what decides between concession and counter-accusation beyond extreme stress with a close friend is not established. Not D: each mode is located with a counterexample.

Within obligations over money, burden and disclosure, section 4.7 gives four dated conflicts with her reasoning on the page: survival against her father's savings (V01 i0108-i0113; whether to survive or attack is OPEN, FXK-V01-C015), a friend's plea against her principle (V04 i0067-i0075), responsibility converted into a duty to disappear and answered by a question about wanting (V08 i0047, i0139), and honesty against a promise (V09 i0078-i0079). The regularity is stated with its exception: she chooses the course that keeps others from knowing or paying and takes the cost herself, except with family money in her own account. The discovery row claims no ethics or ideology dimension, and this grade claims none: no broader moral, political or institutional reasoning of hers is in evidence. Not A: the V09 openness was tested once and kept only in part (V10 i0042-i0045). Not C: the rule, its exception and its V09 change are located.

Section 6.2 documents her humour with examples: puns on Mochiko's name (V07 i0037), sing-song trader coinages, emphasis dots for comic stress (V07 i0073), mock-formality (V07 i0020), English 'ノープロブレム!!', and in 2017 comic armour under exposure ('最高機密! トップシークレット です!', V10 i0044). Outward cheer used as a mask over panic is located (V06 i0148; V07 i0136). Not B: the evidence describes a style and one masking function but does not establish what decides when play appears in ordinary scenes or how it varies by listener beyond these examples. Not D: the style is specific and located across volumes.

She is the protagonist, on nearly every main page of all ten admitted volumes, and the curated monograph covers the complete V01-V10 boundary with paratext excluded and nineteen pages re-opened to verify its quotations (section 14.3). Its claims carry locators and graded labels, and it was independently checked for self-containment and fidelity. Not A: the assessment rests on one derived portrait; the readings, ledger and studies that carry the underlying observations are not curated on this subject, and nothing after V10 i0156 is admitted. Not C: coverage of the admitted boundary is comprehensive rather than sampled.

The monograph supplies affirmative limits and contradictions: counterexamples on every operational row of section 12 (the declined add, V04 i0113-i0115; the protective stop, V05 i0077; the withdrawal, V03 i0124); the contradictions of section 3.4 (strategist and rule-breaker, 勝ち逃げ planned and never done, a friend's money refused and family money taken); an explicit 'Where to abstain' list (trading after V10, authority over another person's open position, intimate life, 2017 residence and pay, responses to secrets never revealed to her, durability of the V09 changes under a new gain); UNTESTED marking of the intimate dimension (section 9); and the abstention after V09 shown as confounded with constraint (section 4.8). Not A: some limits rest on silence rather than on contrary conduct. Not C: the limits are stated affirmatively and located.

States carry story dates, ages and page locators: 15 in October 2008, 20 on 14 February 2014, third-year from April 2014, 21 from 25 October 2014, 23 in April 2017 (section 1); balances by date (section 1 table); the cut at 18:27 on 5 December 2014; forced liquidation on 15 January 2015; bankruptcy discharged in November 2015; the 2017 office scenes to 24 April. Within-volume state changes are split where located. Not A: some dates are unprinted (the V01 night after the May streak, the EUR/CHF entry, the V08 nights given as about three), and the 2015-2017 interval is largely unshown. Not C: the chronology is explicit and fine-grained across the boundary.

conditions: Output is illustrative written Japanese, never quotation; her voice is lettering, so no pitch, tempo, volume or performed delivery is claimed (section 6.7).
Self-reference is 私; address forms follow the section 6.1 table for the sampled person and setting, with 2017 office forms only in the V10 state.

Register follows the located listener and pressure shifts of sections 6.3-6.4: performance and minimal assent to her father before V09 and plain directness from V09; cheerful casual with friends, firm inside that register when refusing; service and stock politeness with strangers and at work; childlike fragments or politeness as a wall under panic.
Inner and outer speech diverge where she is exposed: reassurance in speech or chat over distress shown in thought or body (section 6.5).
Lexicon is dated: war framing and 自己責任 through V08, 自己責任 absent from her speech from V09, 爆損 rather than 爆益 in 2017.

The interlocutor is her father, Mochiko, Mebuki, Yasuko, Kizuna, Nana, Inago, a convenience-store co-worker or customer, or her mother's photograph or grave; another friend of her age is a separate, lower-confidence condition limited to the register rules.
scenario_readiness.note: The address table, listener and pressure shifts, inner-outer gap and dated lexicon constrain illustrative Japanese text closely enough for bounded use. Not READY: the evidence is lettering, balloon attribution is graded in places, and no English rendering or performed voice is evidenced. Not NOT_READY: the forms and their triggers are located across ten volumes.

conditions: A money decision in a named V01-V08 state: predict by the section 12 rows (calm analysis and possible refusal; escalation after a gain; sizing toward the remaining gap near a goal; delay of the stop under a moderate open loss; deadline thinking and felt incapacity once protected money is in her position), keeping each row's counterexamples as live alternatives.

A request to borrow or lend for trading in a V01-V08 state: predict refusal of a friend's money and of funding a friend's trading, with care in kind; family money in her own account is the standing exception. From V09 she accepts help offered openly (V09 i0074-i0075, i0107).

Include her overreach and errors: rationalized delay of a stop, a goal moved before it is reached, cheerful reassurance over distress, and accurate insight that does not govern the decision it concerns.

After V09: disclosure is chosen rather than discovered, help offered openly is accepted, and a vow she might break is refused in favour of openness; a new trading decision after V09 is not predicted either way, because her abstention is confounded with discharge, her father's control of her wages and 22,963 yen in assets.
Authority over another person's open position is untested and is not predicted (section 12, 'Where to abstain').

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state from the temporal boundary: before the first trade (V01, February 2014); the V01-V05 run to the realized peak; V06 after the hand cuts and the repudiated stop rule; V07-V08 after the ruin; or V09-V10 after the disclosure and bankruptcy. Her memories of 2008-2009, her childhood and the 2012 friendship belong to her at every later state; secrets the page never reveals to her (Mochiko's 2012 thought and V07 account, the V03 disclosure, the 狂人 label, Mebuki's loan) stay unknown to her in every state.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Her father; Mochiko as friend and, from V09, employer; Mebuki and Yasuko as university friends; Kizuna, Nana and Inago as 2017 colleagues; a co-worker or customer at the convenience store. Another friend of her age is a separate, lower-confidence transfer; romantic partners, strangers in authority and family beyond her parents are unsampled.
setting_constraints: Contemporary Japan within her located circumstances: home with her father or alone, university, the convenience store, a friends' meal or group chat, the 2017 office.
No real market history, no market outcome invented to settle a prediction, no post-V10 trading, no custody of another person's position, no romantic or intimate scene and no cross-series setting.

scenario_readiness.note: Bounded extrapolation supported by a conditional account with counterexamples and an explicit abstention list. Not READY: the account is untested as a model, the motive question stays open, and the V09 changes are tested only by abstention. Not NOT_READY: the conditions that change her choices are located and stated.

conditions: Settings sampled by the monograph: housework and meals with or for her father, convenience-store shifts, meals and leisure with university friends, the friends' group chat, and the 2017 office and its welcome party.
Predict diligence, frugality, small generosity, hospitality and playful warmth (sections 5.1-5.2, 8); repeated chart-checking where she trades, and attention to colleagues' screens in 2017.
Where she holds a large open position or a concealed loss, ordinary cheer may mask distress (V06 i0148; V07 i0136).
Her 2017 residence, pay and private life outside the office are not established and are not filled in.
scenario_readiness.note: HIGH-support ordinary conduct across ten volumes, bounded to the sampled settings and dated states. Not READY: the 2017 private life is unprinted and the condition on concealed stress must be applied. Not NOT_READY: the habits recur across settings.

conditions: Conflicts of obligation over money, burden and disclosure among family, friends and colleagues, in a named state.
Through V08, predict the course that keeps others from knowing or paying, with the cost taken on herself, and concealment from her father; family money in her own account is the exception.
From V09, predict chosen disclosure, accepted help offered openly and refusal of a promise she might break, with openness kept only in part toward new acquaintances (V10 i0042-i0045).
Moral, political or institutional questions beyond her own obligations are not evidenced and are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Four located obligation conflicts with her reasoning, a stated regularity and its exception. Not READY: the V09 stance was tested once. Not NOT_READY: the reasoning is on the page in each case.

Not assessed: romantic conduct is untested (section 9). The evidence boundaries are recorded as the intimate-untested known limit: one dated SELF_REPORT of absence (V05 i0155) and the monograph's explicit abstention ('nothing should be extrapolated'). No state is claimed either way, so this records no finding about how she would behave in a romantic situation.

conditions: Her own trading in a named V01-V08 state, by the section 12 rows and their counterexamples.
Convenience-store work and the 2017 clerk role ('事務と雑用'): conscientious, service register, small accurate attentions such as the right mug for Kizuna's order (V10 i0113).
Advising others on their money: hedged calls with a disclaimer, a soft request to stop made once, a warning and then assent; she does not fund another person's trading (section 12, MODERATE).
No trading after V09 is predicted, and authority over another person's open position is untested.
scenario_readiness.note: Located professional conduct in two jobs and in her own trading. Not READY: the 2017 role is lightly sampled and post-V09 trading is outside the evidence. Not NOT_READY: the trading rows are HIGH or MODERATE-HIGH with counterexamples.

known_limits.statement: Whether she opens an account, uses a stop or returns to the market after V10 is outside the evidence; Mochiko's prediction of her return (FXK-V09-C008) and her own control resolution (FXK-V09-C032) face events after V10 and are not scoreable. A model must abstain.

Her abstention from V09 to the end of V10 coincides with the bankruptcy discharge, her father's management of her wages and 22,963 yen in assets, so it cannot show what she would choose free of those constraints; the V09 changes are tested only by abstention.

Why she trades stays open between restitution (her V01-V08 account), appetite (her V09 SELF_REPORT, qualified by Mochiko on the same page) and the narrator's lucky-win curse. Only the narrower claim is settled: from V04 to V08 the restitution figure and its successors set the size of her bets.
On the V08 night she sits through nine open-loss displays without acting, and the monograph records that stated policy and incapacity cannot be told apart there (UNRESOLVED).

Her returns to the market are depicted as choices owned in her words against her own accurate prediction, but whether they were free of compulsion stays OPEN (FXK-SYN-C007), with reasons on both sides.
The page never gives her authority over another person's open position; what she would do with it is extrapolation, and the monograph lists it under 'Where to abstain'.

The romantic and intimate dimension rests on one dated SELF_REPORT of absence (V05 i0155) and the monograph's abstention: it marks the dimension UNTESTED in her conduct and says nothing should be extrapolated (section 9). A colleague's proposition to her father occurs outside her presence (V09 i0065-i0066); Yasuko's group-chat warning does reach her, and she sees it without understanding the term (V09 i0093). These are evidence boundaries, not a finding about romantic behavior.
Her voice is lettering, balloon shape and placement; tone, volume and timing are inferred, some balloon attributions are graded, and no performed voice is evidenced.

Parts of her course are visibly designed (her balance equal to her mother's to the yen, the redrawn 「すみませんでした」 composition, the re-presented beach memory), and the comedy-of-chance reading (FXK-SYN-C006, restricted) would treat parts of her psychology as the plot's instrument.

The monograph's section 12 states that its operational profile is an analytic summary, not a reconstruction model, and has not been tested or validated as one; no validation or probe of predictions against held-out pages is curated.
Her childhood beyond V01's captions comes chiefly through V06's flashback, whose authority is mixed (journal self-report, narrator, scenes beyond the journal, framed as her reading).

The volume readings, the decision and evidence ledger, the specialist studies and the audits that carry the underlying observations are not curated on this subject, so every claim here rests on the portrait's summaries and locators.
Her 2017 residence, pay and remaining tax are unprinted, and the 2015-2017 interval is largely unshown.
